name: Dominate
text: Activate any single NPC within 8" as if they had 1/2 AP. This counts as the models activation, this model can no longer be activated in any other step.

name: Flare
text: Choose a mana token on the battlefield within 8" and line of sight: every model within 2" of the token suffers 1/3 damage. The mana token is then removed from play.

name: Puppet
text: Choose a model within 6" and line of sight: push that model 1"/3".

name: Summon
text: Choose a Shattered friendly model that does not have the Leader keyword and place it back on the board within 5" of the caster and restore 4/6 hp to it.

name: Vigour
text: Restore 3/5 hp to a model in 6" and line of sight of the caster.

name: Wither
text: Choose a model in 6" and line of sight, it suffers 1/4 damage.

name: Blood Whip
text: Choose any model with the *Blood* keyword within 3" and line of sight. The model suffers 1 damage. The caster may then make a melee attack with attacks 1/2*, damage 2/4, range 3". *Number of attacks based on spell success.

name: Congealed Blast
text: Choose any model with the *Blood* keyword within 8" and line of sight, it suffers 2/4 damage. Every model within 2" of that model also suffers 2/4 damage. If the initial target is Shattered by the damage the secondary targets suffer an additional 1 damage.

name: Invigorate
text: Choose a friendly model within 3"/6" and line of sight with the Blood keyword, they may make a free move action.

name: Tide of Vermin
text: Choose 1/2 model/s within 8" and line of sight, they suffer 1/2 damage then you may push them 1"/2".

name: Bone Armour
text: Choose any friendly model with the Bone keyword within 3" and line of sight, it suffers 4/6 damage. The caster is then armour +1/+2 for the rest of the game. This spell may only be cast once per game.

name: Bone Spear
text: Choose any model with the *Bone* keyword within 5" and line of sight, it suffers 2 damage. The caster may then make a ranged attack with attacks: 1, damage 3/6 range: 6". *if the channelling roll is a success the attack gains +1/+1 damage.

name: Teeth
text: Choose any model with the Bone Keyword within 3", the model suffers 1 damage. Then choose up to 1/2 additional models within 3" of that model, the caster may then make a ranged attack against each with attacks: 1, damage 1/4 range: 6".

name: Tireless Command
text: Choose a friendly model with the Bone keyword within 3"/5" and line of sight, they may make a free attack action with a melee weapon.

name: Blink
text: Choose a friendly model within 3" and line of sight, push that model 3"/5" as if it had the fly keyword.

name: Phantasm
text: Place a friendly phantasm model within 2"/5" of the caster. This phantasm disappears at the end of the battle. This spell can only be cast once per scenario. The Phantasm has the keywords Plasm and Fly, a 25mm base, AP 1, M 5, Violence –, Ranged – and HP 10; it may not make Attack actions, but can otherwise act as normal.

name: Plasmic Emberburst
text: Every model (besides the caster) within 3" suffers 1/3 damage and is pushed 3" directly away from the caster.

name: Plasmic Shield
text: Select a model within 3/6" and line of sight, that model has +1 armour up to a maximum of 4 until the casters next activation.

name: Spectral Pull
text: Push an objective or relic model within 4"/7" and line of sight 3".
